questions.question: Define classification and regression.
questions.solution_html:
•  Classification
  • A supervised learning method that assigns data into discrete
  • categories
  • (e.g., spam vs non-spam emails)
  •  Regression
  • A supervised learning method used to predict continuous numerical
  • values
  • (e.g., predicting house prices)
  • Key Difference
  • Classification → categorical output
  • Regression → numerical output

questions.question: Classify the main approaches to simulating the human brain, such as bottom-up / and top-down methods.
questions.solution_html:
• Classify the main approaches to simulating the human brain, such as bottom
  • upand top-down methods.
  •  Bottom-Up Approach
  • o Builds intelligence from basic units (neurons)
  • o Example: Artificial Neural Networks
  • o Focus on learning from data

  • o Uses rules, logic, and symbolic reasoning
  • o Example: Expert systems
  • o Focus on human knowledge representation
  • Classification

  •  Top-down → Rule-based

questions.question: Discuss the role of neural network architecture in smart electronic systems.
questions.solution_html:
•  Determines how data flows through the system (input → hidden →
  • output layers)

  •  Supports automation in smart devices (IoT, robotics, smart homes)

questions.question: Draw and label a simple deep neural network architecture.
questions.solution_html:
• Draw and label a simple deep neural network architecture.
  •  Input Layer: Receives raw data and determines the input dimension, with
  • nodes equal to input features.
  •  Hidden Layers: One or more layers (e.g., Dense/Fully Connected) containing
  • neurons that compute a weighted sum of inputs and apply non-linear
  • activations.
  •  Output Layer: Produces the final prediction, such as a single value for
  • regression or multiple probabilities for classification (e.g., Softmax).
  •  Weights and Biases: Learnable parameters connected to each node that are
  • updated through training to minimize error.
questions.final_answer: updated through training to minimize error
